deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Please note that since Shopify is not detected, we will provide the default guide as per your request.
To embed a returns reason capture form into a Shopify returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Shopify admin interface and navigate to "Settings" > "Apps".
2. Click on "Get more apps" and search for a suitable app that supports returns management with customizable forms.
3. Install the selected app and follow its setup instructions to integrate it with your Shopify store.
4. Once the app is installed, go to the "Returns" section in your Shopify admin interface.
5. Click on the "Return reasons" tab and select the return reason you want to capture using a form.
6. In the "Form settings" section, enable the "Capture customer input" option and customize the form as needed.
7. Save the changes and test the returns flow with a sample order to ensure the form is working correctly.
If you need further assistance or have questions about the process, please contact Shopify support for help.
